import '@design-schema/lit';
import { html } from 'lit';
import type { TabsItem } from '@design-schema/lit';

const TABS: TabsItem[] = [
  { id: 'overview', label: 'Overview' },
  { id: 'activity', label: 'Activity', badge: '3' },
  { id: 'files', label: 'Files', icon: 'external' },
  { id: 'settings', label: 'Settings', disabled: true },
];

html`
  <ds-tabs
    label="Project sections"
    .tabs=${TABS}
    activation="automatic"
    orientation="horizontal"
    fit="start"
    keep-mounted
  >
    <ds-tab-panel id="overview">Overview panel.</ds-tab-panel>
    <ds-tab-panel id="activity">Activity panel.</ds-tab-panel>
    <ds-tab-panel id="files">Files panel.</ds-tab-panel>
    <ds-tab-panel id="settings">Settings panel.</ds-tab-panel>
  </ds-tabs>
`;
